items.rationale: The theft-damaged frame is covered at the cost of a like-for-like replacement under 7.1.7(b) and 7.1.9. The EUR 3,500 agreed value replaces the EUR 500 class limit under 4.4, so no rateable reduction is expected.
The brakes were damaged in the theft; 7.1.7(b) and 7.1.9 cover a comparable brake set, estimated at EUR 190 gross before separately billed fitting.
Section 7.1.7(f) covers necessary repair freight. Allow EUR 30 gross for parts shipping, provided it does not duplicate transport billed elsewhere.
Sections 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(f) allow a separate trip if required for the covered repair. Allow EUR 40 gross for one necessary attendance distinct from the locksmith call-out.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers fitting, alignment and testing of the replacement frame and brakes. Allow EUR 175 gross for assembly work not already billed in the hourly lines.
Section 7.1.7(e) allows a grouped charge for fixings and consumables used in the repair. Allow EUR 12 gross, excluding tools and general overhead.
Section 7.1.7(d) covers necessary apprentice labour at the customary rate. Allow one hour at EUR 35 gross if not already included in assembly.
Section 7.1.7(d) covers necessary skilled labour, subject to the duplicate-charge exclusion in 7.1.8(g). Allow one distinct hour at EUR 70 gross.
The on-site locksmith attendance was necessary to recover the bicycle and is separately covered under 5.2.2(a). Allow EUR 40 gross for the trip, consistent with Case 23.

Under 5.2.2(b) and 7.1.10, the charge is assessed by its purpose: cutting and removing the seized lock to release the bicycle. Allow EUR 110 gross for the release operation, consistent with Case 23, excluding any labour billed twice.
Section 5.2.2(b) covers materials consumed in releasing the lock, but not ordinary tool overhead under 7.1.8(d). Allow EUR 7 gross if the charge is for actual consumables, consistent with Case 23.
Section 5.2.2(b) covers all labour grades employed on the release. Allow one hour at EUR 35.50 gross, matching Case 23, if separately incurred.

Section 5.2.2(b) covers skilled release labour, but 7.1.8(g) bars labour already included in the flat charge. If separately justified, allow EUR 42 gross for the billed hour, consistent with the upper bound in Case 23.
